source_policy: Derived statistics and source-behavior conclusions only; original Softimage assets are not committed.

relation_code401.conclusion: The remaining code-401 +90 frontier is rotation-only in the validated archival scene corpus. Four records previously counted as non-identity are only floating decomposition residue around 1e-7..1e-6 radians and are treated as identity at a 1e-5 tolerance.

raw_uv_validation_constraint.conclusion: Raw HRC polygon UVs cannot by themselves determine the +90 matrix direction.
raw_uv_validation_constraint.reason: Softimage keeps texture-projection-definition S/R/T separate from the raw texture projection cluster. Editing the projection transform does not change the UVs shown in the Texture Editor until the projection transformation is frozen/baked. Texture.GetTransformValues is the API that computes the fully transformed UVW values from the raw projection plus projection definition, texture-level effects and image-clip effects.
raw_uv_validation_constraint.implication: A raw-HRC-UV versus +90 candidate comparison is invalid unless a known freeze transition or transformed UV reference is available. Matrix-direction validation should instead use a frozen-before/after source pair, an authoritative formula/source implementation, or a visual/source application case that evaluates the transformed projection.

implementation_policy.why: This excludes four sub-microradian-to-microradian decomposition residues while preserving the smallest clearly authored rotation in the relation-aware corpus (~0.00646 rad).
implementation_policy.current_behavior: Only the 129 meaningful rotation-bearing code-401 layers remain deferred for exact +90 direction. The four noise-only layers now use the normal identity-matrix generated-UV path.
implementation_policy.next_target: Recover the exact UVW rotation application/direction; scale and translation do not need to be solved simultaneously for the current code-401 corpus.
